dedupe_keys.name: global hybrid map of annual herbaceous cropland at 500 m for 2019 worldcereal and umd fusion

description: This global map of annual herbaceous cropland extent for 2019 at 500 m fuses two recent high resolution products, the European Space Agency's WorldCereal and the University of Maryland cropland layer. The Zenodo record says it accompanies a publication that was in submission and that the validation data are published separately. It was deposited in March 2024 by Steffen Fritz of the International Institute for Applied Systems Analysis under the CC BY 4.0 licence, free to download as one zip of about 150 MB. Coverage is global for 2019. Caveats: the file format inside the zip and the fusion rules are not stated on the page read, and permanent crops are outside the herbaceous class. For simulation it gives a coarse, consistent cropland mask to weight agricultural hazard exposure in global models. Related catalogue records include the FAO cropland agreement map and the WorldCereal harmonized reference data.
